_description: Single one-time home purchase at age 66, entered in future dollars, 0% return, 0% inflation. Tests that isOneTime correctly deducts from portfolio only in the purchase year.
_rationale: 500k savings, 0% return, 0% inflation, no retirement spending, no tax (Florida). Home purchase of 100k at age 66 with inflationAdjusted=false (future dollars, no scaling). startYear = 2026 + (66-65) = 2027. Year 2026 (i=0): path[0]=500k, no purchase. Year 2027 (i=1): path[1]=500k (recorded before cash flow), purchase deducts 100k, balance -> 400k. Year 2028 (i=2): path[2]=400k, isOneTime so no repeat. 100% probability (never runs out).
name: Home Purchase
